report_comment.text: COL1A1 encodes the alpha-1 chain of type I collagen. PDGFB encodes the B-chain ligand of platelet-derived growth factor. COL1A1::PDGFB is a recurrent fusion in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, including fibrosarcomatous tumors. Imatinib demonstrated clinical activity in advanced COL1A1::PDGFB-associated dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, including fibrosarcomatous tumors, in pooled phase II trials.
